subject.title: Discord native skill commands can drop SKILL.md command-args choices and fall back to generic input

question: Should OpenClaw add a public structured command-argument schema for user-invocable skills across native channel commands?
rationale: The requested metadata is absent from both the reported release and current canonical skill contract, so implementation would create a new cross-channel public API rather than repair established behavior.

options.title: Sponsor shared schema
options.body: Define typed arguments and choices in the core skill and command contracts, document them, and map them consistently across supported native channels.

options.title: Keep raw input
options.body: Retain generic raw skill-command input and explicitly document nested `command-args` frontmatter as unsupported.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shared schema
recommendation.body: Define typed arguments and choices in the core skill and command contracts, document them, and map them consistently across supported native channels.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the skill-command exposure and subsystem boundary where this public contract would begin.
